tasks.short: Use a treatment method with the client.

steps.what: Read the client's notes before choosing a treatment method.
Decide the variety of treatment methods, such as psychotherapy, hypnosis, behavior modification, stress reduction therapy, or psychodrama.
Use the chosen method with the client in the session.

tasks.design: She reads the notes, decides the method, and uses it with the client. She still opens the notes and still holds the session. No listing replaces that reading, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method depends on what she sees in this client during the session.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new conducts psychotherapy, hypnosis, or the other methods for her.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong method can harm the client, and only she is in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She can change the method because she is with the client.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the notes, chooses the method, and holds the session.

reach.task: use a treatment method with a pupil
reach.learn: The method is what she used in the session, not a menu of names.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the notes, chooses the method, and uses it with the client. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one session with one client, using one method such as psychotherapy. One episode is that session.
The client is outside the organisation. The session is spoken in the room. No session version is written or sent, so the session is not gated.
She still opens and reads the notes. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a written session note sits on another task.
research_questions: Who else may see the client if she is away.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One session in which she uses one method with one client. She still conducts the whole session, so nothing is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a therapeutic plan from the client's needs.

steps.what: Read the clients' interests, abilities, and needs.
Decide the therapeutic aims based on those needs.
Develop therapeutic and treatment plans as plan v1.
File plan v1 as the standing treatment plan.

tasks.design: She reads the client's interests, abilities, and needs, decides the aims, writes plan v1, and files that version. She still opens the history and still writes the plan. No listing replaces that reading, and the plan is not sent out.
tasks.previous_blocker: The aims depend on this client's interests and needs, which she judges.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new writes a therapeutic plan she can file without rewriting.
tasks.still_hard: A plan that misses a need can shape the wrong care.
tasks.human_edge: She can refuse an aim that does not fit this client.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the needs, writes plan v1, and files it.

reach.task: read a therapeutic plan before testing
reach.learn: The aims are what she wrote in plan v1 from the client's own needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the interests and needs, writes the therapeutic plan, and files it. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one therapeutic plan for one client. One episode is that plan.
She writes plan v1 herself. Filing plan v1 is the only standing version, and she approves that file herself.
Talking the plan through with the client is the treatment session, not this task. No plan is sent outside.
She still opens and reads the history. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a psychiatrist must countersign plan v1.
research_questions: Whether the client must sign plan v1 before she files it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One therapeutic plan for one client, written from that client's interests and needs. She still reads those needs and still writes and files the plan.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set and carry out an individual treatment plan.

steps.what: Read the individual case before specifying frequency, intensity, and duration of therapy.
Decide the frequency, intensity, and duration of therapy.
Develop individual treatment plans as course v1.
File course v1 as the standing individual treatment plan.
Implement course v1 with the client in the room.

tasks.design: She reads the individual case, decides frequency, intensity, and duration, writes course v1, files it, and implements that therapy with the client. She still opens the case and still holds the session. No listing replaces that reading, and course v1 is not sent out.
tasks.previous_blocker: Frequency, intensity, and duration depend on this client's case, which she judges.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new sets the course or carries out the therapy for her.
tasks.still_hard: A course that is too intense can harm the client, and only she is in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She can stop the session if the client cannot continue.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still specifies the course, files it, and implements it.

reach.task: note the therapy frequency before a test
reach.learn: Frequency, intensity, and duration are what she wrote in course v1.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still reads the case, specifies the course, files it, and implements the therapy. No tool is added.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one individual course for one client, then one session in which she implements it. One episode is that course plus that session.
She writes course v1 herself. Filing course v1 is the only standing version, and she approves that file herself.
The client is outside the organisation. Implementing the therapy is spoken in the room. No session version is sent, so that step is not gated.
She still opens and reads the case. No listing replaces that reading. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether the employer stores course v1 in a record system she must also update.
research_questions: Whether a colleague must countersign course v1 before she implements it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One individual plan that states frequency, intensity, and duration, then one session in which she implements it. She still does both.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Maintain a watch for relevant research she has not opened.
Read that research to keep current knowledge.
Decide what of that research changes her current knowledge.

tasks.design: She keeps a watch for relevant research, reads it, and decides what changes her knowledge. She still opens and reads each paper. No listing replaces that reading, and no summary is filed in her place.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a paper changes her practice is a judgement she makes after reading it.
tasks.enabler_now: A screening cut for a closed review corpus does not read this week's papers for her.
tasks.still_hard: A paper she has not read can still change what she should do with a client.
tasks.human_edge: She can reject a finding that does not fit the clients she sees.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still opens the research and still decides what to keep.

reach.task: read the same research before a joint case
reach.learn: She has read the paper herself. A ranked set is not a substitute for that reading.

evidence.claim: Across six systematic-review datasets, active learning meant 63.9 to 91.7 percent fewer records were screened to find 95 percent of the relevant ones.
Model knowledge: keeping current means she still opens and reads the papers she uses. That screening result is a different task, so it is not applied as hours here.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
This performance is one sitting in which she reads relevant research to keep current knowledge. One episode is that sitting.
The group prior treats literature work as a screening cut. This task is her own reading. She still opens each paper. The screening case is not used as hours.
No knowledge note is filed, so nothing is gated. No alert is raised.
She still opens and reads the research. No listing replaces that reading.
unknowns: Which journals her employer expects her to follow.
research_questions: Whether a closed review with a recall target is ever part of this task.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: One sitting in which she reads relevant research to keep current knowledge. She still opens and reads it, so nothing is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still holds the treatment sessions, still writes both plans, and still reads the research. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A school psychologist learns a treatment method is what she used in the session.
A neuropsychologist learns the therapeutic aims are what she wrote in plan v1.
A clinical neuropsychologist learns frequency, intensity, and duration sit in course v1.
A medical scientist learns she has read the paper herself.
skills_to_grow: Choose the method while she is with the client.
Write plan v1 from the client's interests and needs.
State frequency, intensity, and duration before she implements the therapy.
Read the research rather than rely on a ranking.
role.ambitious_version: The same psychologist still holds the sessions, still files both plans, and still reads the research. Nothing is sent in her place.
